## Current material

**Computation Graphs, Backpropagation & Autograd**

- [Slides (PDF)](slides-pdf/L3.pdf)
- [Presentation mode](slides-pdf/L3-presentation.pdf)
- [Scalar autograd engine (HTML)](notebooks/L03/04_scalar_autograd_pytorch_to_scratch.html)
- [Scalar autograd engine (Colab)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/nipunbatra/dl-teaching/blob/master/notebooks/L03/04_scalar_autograd_pytorch_to_scratch.ipynb)
- [Scalar autograd engine source (IPYNB)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nipunbatra/dl-teaching/master/notebooks/L03/04_scalar_autograd_pytorch_to_scratch.ipynb)
- [Complete lecture notebook (HTML)](notebooks/L03/00_backprop_autograd_complete.html)
- [Complete lecture notebook (Colab)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/nipunbatra/dl-teaching/blob/master/notebooks/L03/00_backprop_autograd_complete.ipynb)
- [Complete notebook source (IPYNB)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nipunbatra/dl-teaching/master/notebooks/L03/00_backprop_autograd_complete.ipynb)

The focused scalar notebook uses literal PyTorch tensors and `.backward()`, then rebuilds the exact graph with one small `Value` record. It exposes saved parent links and local derivatives, traces all seven reverse-edge updates as upstream × local = downstream contribution, and shows the Graphviz graph before and after backward. The complete notebook continues through symbolic and finite-difference checks, branch accumulation, a dense-layer VJP, a three-example mean batch, equivalent microbatches, one optimizer step, and a tiny MLP.
